action: Ipsos says it will contact clients, project or business partners directly if its investigation finds their information was affected.
exec: Ipsos says a breach of one internal system had no impact on its operations; its investigation is ongoing.
plain: Market research company Ipsos said on 16 November that one of its internal information systems was breached. It says operations were not affected and it has filed a complaint with the authorities.
summary: Ipsos announced on 16 November that it filed a complaint with the authorities on 11 November over a breach of one of its internal information systems, and says the incident had no impact on its operations. Its statement did not say what kind of incident it was. Security.nl reported on 24 November that the Qilin ransomware group claims to have stolen files, citing a Hackmanac post on X; Ipsos has not confirmed the scope.
title: Ipsos reports a breach of one internal information system

validation.note: Ipsos press release (distributed by Finanzwire) read; Security.nl reports the same statement and adds the Qilin claim, which rests on a Hackmanac post.

date_note: Date is the day Ipsos announced it; the page gives no earlier announcement day. Ipsos says it filed its complaint on 11 November.
